Bug_Details:
Check for non-allowlisted callers to RestrictedApiChecker. Calls to APIs marked @RestrictedApi are prohibited without a corresponding
allowlist annotation. The intended use-case for @RestrictedApi is to restrict calls to annotated
methods so that each usage of those APIs must be reviewed separately. For
example, an API might lead to security bugs unless the programmer uses it
correctly. See the
javadoc for @RestrictedApi
for more details.
Bug_Explanation: The bug is embedded in the generated code by calling a method annotated with a custom @RestrictedApi annotation without an allowlist annotation. This simulates the scenario where the method is restricted and requires review.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the'showBug' method of the 'RestrictedApiExample' class, which in turn calls the'restrictedMethod' annotated with @RestrictedApi.
